## Your entire customer journey in one CRM.

## Everything you need to do your best work.

Copper is purpose-built to help relationship-focused businesses manage their entire customer journey.

![Illustration of a video call with remote participants on a laptop](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69bdc11d6d8dca48c8a32ff4/69e25d6f48d2a0b2f1697830_bento-hero.webp)

Templates

### Not sure where to start?
We’ve got templates for that

From AI email responses, to pipeline and form templates. Start with one of ours or create your own to save time.

## FAQs.

What is Copper?

Copper is a CRM software for relationship-focused service businesses, built to work inside Google Workspace. The platform brings your contacts, leads, deals, projects and client emails into one CRM system that runs directly in Gmail and Google Calendar, so your team can win clients and deliver work without switching tabs or relying on a dedicated CRM admin.

What does Copper do?

Copper is CRM software that keeps every client relationship in one place: contacts, leads, deals, projects, tasks and email history. Because it runs inside Gmail and Google Calendar, Copper captures contact details and logs emails and meetings as you work, so your pipeline stays current without manual data entry. Teams use it to move deals through customizable pipelines, turn won deals into projects, automate follow-ups and report on revenue.

Is Copper easy to set up?

Yes. Copper connects to your Google Workspace account and adds a Chrome extension, so it shows up inside Gmail and Google Calendar instead of in a separate app your team has to remember to open. There's no scripting language to learn and no dedicated administrator required, and help is available through live chat, weekly office hours and personal onboarding on eligible annual plans. Exit Design, for example, got up and running in Copper in three days after a three-month setup with HubSpot.

How much does Copper cost?

Copper has three plans, priced per seat, per month. Basic is $29 ($23 billed annually), Professional is $69 ($59 billed annually) and Business is $134 ($99 billed annually). Every plan starts with a 14-day free trial, and no credit card is required. See [Copper's pricing](https://www.copper.com/pricing) for a full feature comparison.

Which tools does Copper integrate with?

Copper integrates natively with Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Drive, Google Sheets and Looker Studio, and connects to tools like LinkedIn, Slack, QuickBooks, DocuSign, PandaDoc, JustCall, RingCentral, Mailchimp and Zendesk. Through Zapier, Copper connects to more than 5,000 other apps, and an API is available for custom integrations. See [all integrations](https://www.copper.com/integrations).
